title: The Horizon of the Sepik Basin
author: Petra Amberdale
blurb: Jude Almeida, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must cross the range ahead of the snows before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
